Full-time Air Conditioning Technician position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Parklea, NSW 2768. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Air Conditioning Technician
•	$80,000 – $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:

Streamair Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based specialist in the installation, servicing and maintenance of residential and commercial air conditioning systems. The company is committed to delivering reliable, energy-efficient HVAC solutions with a strong focus on quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. As an Air Conditioning Technician at Streamair Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for installing, commissioning, servicing and repairing air conditioning and refrigeration systems while ensuring compliance with Australian Standards and WHS requirements. This role requires excellent technical ability, problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Interpret technical drawings, plans and specifications to determine installation requirements for air conditioning and refrigeration systems.
•	Install, commission and test residential and commercial air conditioning and refrigeration equipment.
•	Fabricate, assemble and install refrigerant pipework and associated components using approved brazing and soldering techniques.
•	Charge refrigeration systems with refrigerant, perform pressure and leak detection tests, and ensure compliance with Australian Standards.
•	Diagnose faults in compressors, condensers, evaporators, motors, thermostats and control systems, carrying out repairs or component replacements as required.
•	Perform preventative maintenance, inspections and scheduled servicing to maximise equipment performance and energy efficiency.
•	Dismantle, repair and reassemble refrigeration and air conditioning units using appropriate testing equipment and specialised tools.
•	Test completed installations, adjust system controls and verify correct operation before project handover.
•	Maintain accurate service reports, maintenance records and documentation relating to installations, repairs and inspections.
•	Liaise professionally with customers, suppliers and other trades while ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements and refrigerant handling regulations.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification appropriate to the role
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an Air Conditioning Technician.
•	Sound knowledge of HVAC and refrigeration systems, controls and components.
•	Strong fault-finding, diagnostic and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings and work independently or within a team.
•	Commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship and excellent customer service.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $80,000 – $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply:
11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

Have you used SQL, SSMS, BigQuery or similar tools to explore and validate data sources? Please provide an example.

What experience do you have working within Agile or project delivery environments?

Please advise your availability to commence employment and any notice period required.

Please outline your salary expectations (exclusive of superannuation).

Westside Auto Wholesale, a family-run private company, is the leading West Australian used car dealership and is home to the largest vehicle range in Australia. We are seeking highly skilled and experienced Motor Mechanic to join and work with our team of hardworking professionals who share a common drive to make a difference in the industry.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Conduct regular repair, test, and maintenance services such as oil change, lubrications, and engine tune-ups of motor vehicles, machinery, and other mechanical components
Create a plan of action for all maintenance tasks and upgrades
Meet with clients to better understand their concerns and identify the issue
Provide high-quality service to clients to help them identify, repair, and avert issues that may affect the performance or longevity of their motor vehicles
Generate timelines and estimates for repairs, discussing options with clients.
Detect and diagnose faults in engines and parts
Disassemble/assemble mechanical components according to specifications.
Repair or replace worn, old or defective parts of motor vehicles, ensuring replaced parts are checked and tested using proper testing equipment
Examine machines and oversee diagnostic tests to determine functionality problems.
Maintain and document work logs, repairs, and maintenance records.
Monitor inventory and order new parts when necessary.
Suggest/Propose maintenance and preventative procedures to machine and vehicle users.

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade qualification or Equivalent
Solid experience in a similar role
Proven ability to diagnose and repair vehicles and follow safety instructions and directions.
Analytical, keen to help our clients resolve issues with vehicle performance and appearance
Proficient with mechanic’s tools and other diagnostic equipment.
Physically and mentally fit
Strong attention to details and diagnostic abilities
Strong communications and reporting skills
Customer service skills
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Self-motivated, organised, and reliable with strong work ethic

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Black Cat Civil has grown over 200 employees, 450 pieces of plant, and over 1800 completed projects, across sites in QLD, the NT, and beyond.

Black Cat Civil is currently seeking experienced Mechanical/Hydraulics Technicians to join their growing company on a full time and permanent basis.

Mechanical/Hydraulics Technicians are responsible for overseeing and implementing the installation, maintenance, and repairs for the hydraulic components of equipment on Trucks and Plant Machinery.

Hydraulic installations, pto's, pumps, cylinders, hoists, power packs, wet kits, valving Hydraulic repairs, hoses, resealing cylinders
Installations, repairs and services of truck mounted cranes, tailgate loaders
Electrical, wiring up cranes, tailgate loaders, power packs
Fault finding and carrying out annual services on cranes and tailgate loaders
Auto Electrical knowledge
Reading of hydraulic schematics
Undertake hydraulic maintenance tasks during shut down periods; replacement of hydraulic components, pipework installations, inspections, testing of equipment
Troubleshoot hydraulic issues on fixed plant assets.
Assist in the execution, installation, and commission of bespoke projects;
Ensure a high level of safe work practices undertaken at site

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Installation, maintenance and repair of hydraulic systems
Read blueprints and diagrams while troubleshooting and diagnosing problems
Perform preventative maintenance to avoid operational failures of hydraulic systems
Welding, metal fabrication and electrical assembly
Provide drawing review and suggestions related to part inspection and testing
Use computers and other technologies to investigate and repair hydraulic equipment
Reassemble machines and equipment
Read dials and meters to determine amperage, voltage, electrical output and input at specific operating temperature to analyze parts performance
Operate drill press, grinders, engine lathe, or other machines to modify parts tested or to fabricate experimental parts for testing
